productName: Roronoa Zoro STL 3 Diorama – One Piece
creator: Kiba Studio

mediaReview.notes: All seven staged renders are distinct views of the same Kiba Studio diorama. No unrelated third-party promotional badge, Telegram/group branding, reseller URL, QR code or repost handle was observed.

identityReview.notes: The only published Zoro candidate is a different sculpture: its pose, base and blue wave-like effect differ materially from the reviewed Kiba Studio skull-rock diorama with green/teal slicing effects. No reviewed source view is perceptually close to the existing cover.

decision.nextGate: validate batch 007 creator-attribution proof and exact deterministic identity in release preflight; production apply remains explicitly gated
